templates.summary: A fleet management back end: cloud hosting, fleet telemetry and route distances in sequence, then either the classic routing path (80%) or a quantum optimiser (20%), then payment. Hand-made candidates with cost, execution time, availability, reliability and security; no offering, so no margins.
templates.title: Fleet management system

templates.summary: TomatoMeter's back end: sign in, send the daily summary e-mail and export the data in parallel, then fetch a quote. The e-mail and storage providers are real SPHERE plans; the offering is TomatoMeter's own pricing in SPHERE.
